api_password.description: Password to access the dnsdist API web interface

api_acl.description: List of IP subnets allowed to access the API and perform recursive queries

backends.description: List of upstream DNS backends (authoritative servers or resolvers) to forward queries to

host.description: Hostname or IP of the backend server

port.description: UDP/TCP port of the backend server

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the backend

tcp_only.description: If true, only use TCP to connect to this backend (useful for DoT/DoH upstreams)

weight.description: Weight for weighted round-robin (higher = more queries routed)

max_qps.description: Maximum QPS allowed to this backend before throttling

qps_limit.description: Per-client QPS limit to this backend

order.description: Priority order (lower = used first); used with 'FirstAvailablePolicy'

pool.description: Backend pool name for grouping (used by policies)

health_check_name.description: Domain name used for health checks (e.g., 'healthcheck.example.com')

max_rtt.description: Maximum acceptable RTT in ms before marking backend unhealthy

rate_limits.description: Client-subnet–based rate limits (per subnet, in QPS, with optional action)

subnet.description: Client IP subnet (CIDR) to apply the limit to

qps.description: Maximum queries per second for this subnet

action.description: Action to take when limit exceeded: 'drop', 'throttle', 'nxdomain', etc.

rules.description: Custom query routing rules (match expression + action)

address.description: IP to bind DoH listener to

port.description: Port to bind DoH listener to

cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format)

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format)

enable_x_forwarded_for.description: Parse X-Forwarded-For header for client IP
